name: Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires nomination by an approved Australian employer for a role on the Core Skills Occupation List.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a nomination from an approved employer.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires an annual salary of at least $79,423 AUD (2026 Core Skills Income Threshold) or the Annual Market Salary Rate, whichever is higher.
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a salary meeting the threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires nomination by an approved employer for a highly specialised role, not restricted to a fixed occupation list.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a nomination from an approved employer for a specialist role.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires an annual salary of at least $146,576 AUD (2026 Specialist Skills Income Threshold).
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a salary meeting the specialist threshold.

outcome.duration_length: up to 4 years, renewable while sponsored

sources.title: Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482) - Department of Home Affairs

notes: MAJOR STRUCTURAL FINDING, genuine renaming/restructuring not previously known: this route was called the 'Temporary Skill Shortage' (TSS) visa until 7 December 2024, when it was replaced by the 'Skills in Demand' visa — SAME subclass number (482), fundamentally restructured framework (two new streams, Core Skills and Specialist Skills, each with its own income threshold, replacing the old Short-term/Medium-term/Labour Agreement stream structure). Any secondary source still describing subclass 482 as the 'Temporary Skill Shortage' visa or referencing the old stream names is describing a superseded framework, not just using an old fee figure — the same class of methodology-level staleness first identified on France's Passeport Talent threshold. leads_to_pr is FALSE here (unlike most work_sponsored routes in this dataset) since 482 is genuinely temporary and provisional — the real path to permanence is switching to au_employer_nomination_186 via its Temporary Residence Transition stream after 2+ years, which is where pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months actually apply. Formula-linked to both CSIT and SSIT national variables depending on stream — the only route in this dataset referencing two different formula variables across its own requirement groups.
